description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mahakandegama, Kurunegala  D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420366
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extent, ownership details, and encumbrances) in Kurunegala District. The content focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
